# Example: Scanning openai.com

This example demonstrates a limited scan of https://openai.com using AIFME Scout OSS.

> **Note:** Timestamps in this example are illustrative. Actual scans will reflect the current time.

## Command

```bash
aifme-scout scan https://openai.com --quiet
```

## Output Files

- `scan-result.json` — 253,793 bytes, 154 evidence items
- `report.md` — 9,944 bytes

## Generated Report (Markdown)

```markdown
# Website Intelligence Report

**Target:** https://openai.com
**Report Date:** 2026-08-05
**Generated By:** AIFME Scout OSS 1.0.0

## Executive Summary

**Overall Status:** Limited Scan
**Signal Coverage:** 35%

**Confidence:** Low

**Scan Outcome at a Glance**

| Signal Area | Items Collected | Coverage |
| ----------- | --------------- | -------- |
| Search Engine Optimization | 25 | None detected |
| Brand Metadata | 0 | None detected |
| Technology | 127 | Strong |
| Content | 0 | None detected |
| Social Profiles | 0 | None detected |
| Competitive References | 0 | None detected |

**Overall Assessment**

https://openai.com is classified as a **General Website**.
This scan produced limited results. Anti-bot protection, JavaScript rendering
requirements, robots.txt restrictions, or access restrictions may have prevented
full analysis. The assessment is based on 154 evidence points covering 35% of
available signals.

## Scan Limitations

The following factors may have limited this scan's coverage:

- Anti-bot challenge detected (e.g., Cloudflare, Imperva, DataDome). The scanner
  could not reach the rendered page.

These factors affect scan coverage only, not the quality of the website.
```

## Interpretation

**What this tells us:**

- **Limited scan:** OpenAI.com returns an anti-bot challenge. The scanner could not access the rendered page. This is expected behavior — Scout OSS respects anti-bot protection.
- **Technology detection still works:** Despite the limited scan, 127 technology evidence items were extracted from the challenge page and initial HTML. Cloudflare CDN, Next.js, React, Google Analytics, and Vercel hosting were detected.
- **No content extraction:** Because the actual page content was not accessible, no content, SEO, metadata, social, or competitor signals could be extracted.
- **Classification:** The site is classified as "General Website" due to limited available signals.
- **Transparency:** The report clearly states the limitations and what they mean for the results.

**Use case:** This example demonstrates how Scout OSS handles anti-bot protected sites gracefully — it reports the limitation transparently, extracts whatever signals are available, and never crashes or silently fails.
